title: Are Generative Language Models Multicultural? A Study on Hausa Culture and Emotions using ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting ChatGPT with culturally-dependent scenario questions and comparing its responses to those of native Hausa speakers using emotion analysis, textual similarity metrics (BERTScore, METEOR), and human Likert-scale ratings to assess alignment with Hausa cultural norms and emotional expressions.
